A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a pyridine-imine ligand can be used to construct dinuclear Rh(III) compounds, in which the two metal centers are bridged by a single pyridine-2-imine ligand (1), a single pyridin-1-imine (2, 3, and 4), or two pyridin-2-imines (5).

a C(sp3)-C(sp3) bond can be cleaved in a Rh(III)-mediated C(sp3)-N bond formation.
